sylvia: Quick kickoff for the surgeproof/headroom follow-ups from the PM. We saw repeated short bursts during midday that trigger autoscaler churn. Splitting into three short tracks: quota soak, scheduler A/B, and a daytime smoke monitor. Owners & short targets below — please ack.

 tom: I'll own the quota soak (RW-5001). Plan: request a temporary +12% soft quota for 5 days in a low-traffic window. Need cloud-ops ok + automated rollback script. Target 2026-12-05.

 anika: I'll run the scheduler A/B canary (RW-5002). Test idea: compare preempt_threshold 0.7 vs 0.55 and limit burst_slots. Example staging patch: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"preempt_threshold":"0.55","burst_slots":"10"}}'` Canaried 48h then assess. Target 2026-12-03.

 raj: I'll add the daytime smoke workflow and Grafana alert (RW-5003). Workflow: `.github/workflows/day-smoke-headroom.yml`. Alert: headroom_percent < 12% for 5m during 08:00-20:00 PT. Pager points to runbook. Target 2026-12-02.

 alert-bot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2234567000 and created follow-ups RW-5001, RW-5002, RW-5003.

 sylvia: Consolidated targets: tom RW-5001 (quota soak) target 2026-12-05, anika RW-5002 (scheduler canary) target 2026-12-03, raj RW-5003 (smoke + alerts) target 2026-12-02. I'll run a 10-min async check Mon/Wed until closed. Next sync 2026-11-30 09:00 PT.

 tom: Metrics I want during soak: `gpu_alloc_rate`, `headroom_percent_p10`, `slot_eviction_rate`, `autoscale_events`. Will attach CSV to RW-5001.

 anika: Also tracking `preempt_count`, `tail_latency_p99`, and `queued_batches_p99`. Rollback condition: preempt_count + tail latency > 25% vs baseline.

 raj: Smoke job will be feature-flag gated `feature.headroom_smoke` and include a mute window. Pager runbook + dashboard link added to RW-5003.

 sylvia: Thanks — please ping if you hit RBAC/cloud blockers. Acks?

 tom: Ack.

 anika: Ack.

 raj: Ack :thumbsup:

 sylvia: I'll update the PM with owners & attach this thread.
